items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...black pianists had the same kind of jobs that Lester Lanin and all of those guys had then? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, definitely.

ctx.x: Maybe if he wanted to bring a drummer with him or a guitar player or something like that, okay.
In other words, back in this day, this era black pianists had the same kind of jobs that Lester Lanin and all of those guys had then? They were --
Oh, definitely. And we had a black band in New York that played those jobs, too, way back.
